{{Quote|Gree units fulfill four caste-assignments: Crafter, Operator, Researcher and Administrator. I am Operator. I ensure proper function of Gree ingenuity. Pat-aK is Administrator unit. His sole aptitude is communication-command-governance-argument. I can serve Pat-aK's function. Can he serve mine? No!|[[Hib-R-ak]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''administrator''' caste was one of the four castes of [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] society, alongside [[crafter]], [[operator]], and [[researcher]]. The administrators functioned as the species' government.<ref name="GE" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Pat-aK]] was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] serving the Gree administrator caste.<ref name="TOR" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], only the administrator and operator castes continued to be birthed in the spawning beds due to the decline of Gree society.<ref name="GE" />
